# Ubhaya Fashions

> Official online storefront for women's fashion and ethnic wear in India. Browse products, product sizes and colours, delivery details, and customer support information.

## Storefront

- [Home](https://ubhayafashions.in/): Featured collections and new arrivals.
- [Shop all products](https://ubhayafashions.in/Products): Search and browse the public product catalogue.
- [Shop by category](https://ubhayafashions.in/Products/Categories): Browse available product categories.
- [Contact](https://ubhayafashions.in/Contact): Contact the store about products or orders.
- [Shipping information](https://ubhayafashions.in/Shipping): Read delivery and shipping details.

## Policies

- [Returns and refunds](https://ubhayafashions.in/Home/Returns)
- [Cancellations](https://ubhayafashions.in/Home/Cancellation)
- [Privacy](https://ubhayafashions.in/Home/Privacy)
- [Terms and conditions](https://ubhayafashions.in/Home/Terms)

## Product catalogue

Product detail pages use `/Products/Details/{id}`. Product availability, prices, sizes, and colours can change; read the current product page before answering questions about them.

## Discovery

- [XML sitemap](https://ubhayafashions.in/sitemap.xml): Public pages and product detail URLs.
